selectionSql: SELECT o.id,o.title,o.creator,o.tradition,o.source_key,o.rights,o.source_url,o.image_url,a.kind,a.split FROM research_corpus_object o LEFT JOIN research_corpus_analysis a ON a.id=o.id WHERE o.tradition='Ukraine' AND (o.rights ILIKE '%public domain%' OR o.rights ILIKE '%CC0%') AND lower(o.title)~'(вишив|vyshyv|сороч|рушник|українського орнаменту|ukrainian embroidery|hutsul embroidery)' ORDER BY o.id LIMIT 120
selectionReview: candidate intake by title and stored rights; not verified motif classification or training admission
